''Jyllands Rubin'' (The Ruby of Jutland) | short name = VB | founded = {{Start date and age|1891|5|3|df=yes}}{{cite web |title=Historien |url=https://vejle-boldklub.dk/klubben/historien/ |website=Vejle Boldklub |access-date=3 September 2026 |language=da }} | ground = [[Vejle Stadium]] | capacity = 11,060 (7,567 seated) | chairman = Tage Pedersen{{cite web |title=Vejle Boldklubs nye bestyrelse er på plads |url=https://vejle-boldklub.dk/vejle-boldklubs-nye-bestyrelse-er-paa-plads |website=Vejle Boldklub |date=25 March 2025 |access-date=3 September 2026 |language=da }} | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Claus Nørgaard]] | league = [[Danish 1st Division]] | season = [[2025–26 Danish Superliga|2025–26]] | position = [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]], 12th of 12 (relegated) | pattern_la1 = _vb2526h | pattern_b1 = _vb2526h | pattern_ra1 = _vb2526h | pattern_sh1 = _vb2526h | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_white | leftarm1 = EF0000 | body1 = EF0000 | rightarm1 = EF0000 | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = EF0000 | pattern_la2 = _vb2526a | pattern_b2 = _vb2526a | pattern_ra2 = _vb2526a | pattern_sh2 = _vb2526a | pattern_so2 = _3_stripes_white | leftarm2 = 16544A | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = 16544A | shorts2 = 16544A | socks2 = 000000 | website = {{URL|https://vejle-boldklub.dk}} }} '''Vejle Boldklub''' (commonly known as '''Vejle''' or '''VB''') is a Danish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vejle]], [[Jutland]]. Founded in 1891, the club has won the [[Danish football champions|Danish championship]] five times and the [[Danish Cup]] six times, making it one of the historically most successful clubs in Danish football. The club has a long tradition of developing players for international football. Its most celebrated player is [[Allan Simonsen]], who came through the club before joining [[Borussia Mönchengladbach]] and winning the [[Ballon d'Or]] in 1977. Other prominent players developed by Vejle include [[Johnny Hansen (footballer, born 1943)|Johnny Hansen]], [[Ulrik le Fevre]], [[John Sivebæk]] and [[Thomas Gravesen]]..{{cite web |title=Allan Simonsen fylder rundt |url=https://vejle-boldklub.dk/allan-simonsen-fylder-rundt |website=Vejle Boldklub |access-date=3 September 2026 |language=da }}"}}
